text: 其实以现在的一般社会化水平，二十多岁的年轻人普遍有很多非常执着的对爱的误解，不经历好几次彻底的关系危机是很难成长到能成熟的、低损耗的维持长期积极亲密关系的。
en: Actually, at the current general level of socialisation, young people in their twenties universally hold many very stubborn misconceptions about love; without going through several thorough relationship crises it is very difficult to grow to the point of being able to maintain a long-term positive intimate relationship in a mature, low-cost way.

text: 真正理解人——不仅仅是异性，也包括自身——是怎么回事，什么话不能那样说，什么事不能那样做，什么做法会适得其反，什么东西不能强求，并且在这乱石嶙峋的海域里找到一条可以从容通航的道路，还练出可靠的操帆技巧，这是需要足够的经历去浇灌的。
en: Truly understanding people — not only the opposite sex, but also oneself — what they are really like, what words must not be said in that way, what things must not be done in that way, what behaviour will backfire, what cannot be forced, and finding a route through this jagged rocky sea where one can navigate at ease, and developing reliable sailing skills besides, all of this needs enough experience to nourish it.

text: 如果有非常好的群体抚慰引导、再加上一点运气，二十大几岁可以进入一个健康的婚姻，自然是好。
en: If there is very good communal comfort and guidance, plus a little luck, entering a healthy marriage in one's late twenties is of course good.

text: 但是很多人其实都需要几次糟糕的恋爱和一次婚姻的失败，外加长期的工作上、社会上的历练，才会真的达成成熟——前提还是最后悟出了自己的错处，有机缘经忏悔而圆满。
en: But in fact many people need several bad romances and one failed marriage, plus long-term tempering through work and society, before they truly achieve maturity — provided that in the end they perceive their own faults and have the good fortune to attain fulfilment through repentance.

text: 这一般都要三十多岁才达得到，四十才真正成熟并不少见。
en: This is generally only attained in one's thirties; reaching true maturity only at forty is not uncommon.

text: 一个四十多岁的人还在寻找伴侣，如果还是只看所谓的颜值冲动，贪图所谓的青春活力，只能说要么是前半生有特殊原因没有经历可怕的感情危机，要么就是有了一套行之有效的脱身之策，自信可以安全享受。
en: If a person in their forties is still looking for a partner and still only values so-called physical-attraction impulses and covets so-called youthful vitality, one can only say that either in the first half of their life there was a special reason they never went through a terrible emotional crisis, or that they have developed an effective strategy for slipping away, and are confident they can enjoy themselves safely.

text: 不成熟的价值观乘以亲密关系带来的侵彻力，会给人带来的伤害是能致命的，这一点四十多岁的人应该差不多都明白了。
en: Immature values multiplied by the penetrating force that intimate relationships bring can inflict harm on a person that is fatal; people in their forties should more or less all understand this.

text: 虽然年轻异性有青春魅力，但是真正经寻求宁静生活的中年人并不会把这一点看得多么的重要。
en: Although young people of the opposite sex have youthful charm, middle-aged people who genuinely seek a tranquil life do not regard this as being of much importance.

text: 一些刁蛮任性的东西一发作，人被前女友、前妻留下的创伤记忆就立刻被唤醒了，马上就知道这之后是吵不完的架、不死不休的勉强和要挟，一轮一轮的zs威胁，你美若天仙都没用。
en: Once some wayward and wilful trait flares up, the trauma memories left by former girlfriends and ex-wives are instantly awakened, and one immediately knows that what follows are endless quarrels, relentless coercion and threats that will not rest until death, and round after round of suicide threats — and it would be of no use even if you were beautiful as a fairy.

text: 所以根本就谈不上“普遍都找年轻的”。
en: So it is simply not the case that “everyone universally looks for younger ones”.

text: 大部分是要么不找，要找必须是成熟善良坚强自立的，在这基础上才谈得上年轻、美貌这些次要因素。
en: For the most part they either do not look at all, or if they do look it must be for someone mature, kind, strong and self-reliant; only on that foundation do secondary factors such as youth and beauty come into consideration.

text: 觉得“肯定喜欢年轻的”，其实是自己还太年轻的人们对自己将来的想象而已。
en: Thinking “they definitely prefer younger ones” is in fact merely the imagination that people who are themselves still too young have about their own future.

text: 这种人其实不是主流。
en: Such people are in fact not the mainstream.

text: 四十多岁的人和四十多岁异性终成眷属的例子多得很，只是这些平凡而务实的选择不太是通过相亲这类方式进行的罢了。
en: There are very many examples of people in their forties and people of the opposite sex in their forties ending up as husband and wife; it is merely that these ordinary and pragmatic choices are not really made through means such as blind dates.

text: 一想到10年后就是和一个50岁的大妈一起过日子，就觉得不寒而栗。
en: The mere thought that ten years later one would be sharing daily life with a 50-year-old woman makes one shudder.

text: 我今年刚刚40岁。
en: I have only just turned 40 this year.

text: 三年前跟前妻离婚。
en: Three years ago I divorced my ex-wife.

text: 中间有几个同事给我介绍，我去见了两个，
en: In between, a few colleagues introduced some people to me, and I went to meet two of them,

text: 其中一个35岁，双方都有意愿，后来聊了两个星期，觉得挺累的，
en: One of them was 35; both sides were willing, and later we chatted for two weeks, but I found it quite exhausting,

text: 她有孩子，经常聊了一会，她去给孩子找这个找那个，
en: She had a child, and often after chatting for a while she would go off to fetch this or that for the child,

text: 慢慢的就觉得没啥意思，后来就不聊了。
en: And gradually I felt there was not much to it, and later we stopped chatting.

text: 后来还认识一个20多岁的，还没有发展到确定关系，
en: Later I also got to know a woman in her twenties; we had not yet developed to the point of confirming a relationship,

text: 我也觉得累就不谈了。
en: And I also felt tired, so I let it drop.

text: 20多岁的时候，可以为了她花光所有积蓄，
en: At twenty-something, I could spend every last bit of my savings on her,

text: 因为她不喜欢我玩游戏，把玩了五年的梦幻西游送人，
en: Because she did not like me playing games, I gave away the Fantasy Westward Journey I had played for five years,

text: 可以离开家，放弃更好的工作去1500公里外的福建，
en: I could leave home and give up a better job to go to Fujian, 1,500 kilometres away,

text: 不见睡不着的想她，见了就乐不可支。
en: When apart I could not sleep for longing for her, and when together I was beside myself with joy.

text: 现在40岁，不管漂亮还是丑，都不会有任何的情绪波动。
en: Now at 40, whether beautiful or plain, there is not the slightest emotional fluctuation.

text: 以前打电话，亲情号码999分钟免费，一个星期就打完了。
en: In the past when making phone calls, the family-number plan gave 999 free minutes, and I used them all up in a single week.

text: 现在聊十分钟就觉得没话说，不管是30岁还是20岁，都一样。
en: Now after chatting for ten minutes I feel there is nothing to say, whether she is 30 or 20, it is all the same.

text: 还是更喜欢自己一个人独处，玩玩游戏，跑跑步，钓钓鱼。
en: I still prefer to be alone by myself, playing games, going for a run, fishing.

text: 离婚的时候把钱和房子都留给孩子了，现在工资给爸妈一点，自己留一点，
en: When I divorced I left the money and the house to the child; now I give a bit of my salary to my parents and keep a bit for myself,

text: 剩下的就到处走走，我觉得挺好的。
en: And with the rest I travel about a little; I think it is rather good.

text: 我也奇怪！
en: I also find it strange!

text: 为什么 28岁月薪5000 无房无车的姑娘，不考虑28岁月薪5000 无房无车的男人！
en: Why would a 28-year-old girl on a monthly salary of 5,000 with no house and no car not consider a 28-year-old man on a monthly salary of 5,000 with no house and no car!

text: 为什么刘强东选奶茶妹妹而不选董明珠呢？
en: Why did Qiangdong Liu choose Sister Milk Tea rather than Mingzhu Dong?

text: 身边熟人，女，长得绝对漂亮，公务员，博士，老公是大学同学，也是公务员，双方家庭条件和外形都好。
en: An acquaintance of mine, female, absolutely beautiful, a civil servant, a doctorate holder; her husband was a university classmate, also a civil servant; both families' circumstances and appearances were good.

text: 34岁那年，双方小孩2岁。
en: The year she was 34, their child was 2 years old.

text: 男方公派去美国学习一年，女方考上在职博士。
en: The husband was sent on official assignment to study in the United States for a year; the wife was admitted to a part-time doctorate.

text: 结果据说男方和一同赴美学习的某女同学搞上了，其被女方发现。
en: As a result, it is said the husband got involved with a certain female classmate who had gone to America to study with him, and this was discovered by the wife.

text: 女方无法接受，坚决要求离婚。
en: The wife could not accept it and firmly demanded a divorce.

text: 最后，双方协议离婚，女儿归女方抚养。
en: In the end, the two parties divorced by agreement, and the daughter was placed in the wife's custody.

text: 分割财产女方分得超过千万市值。
en: In the division of property, the wife received assets with a market value of over ten million.

text: 男方后来也没跟那个女同学结婚，而是找了一个20多岁的未婚姑娘再婚，双方又有了孩子。
en: The husband later did not marry that female classmate either, but instead found an unmarried woman in her twenties and remarried, and the two had a child again.

text: 男方现在已官居厅长。
en: The husband now holds the post of department director.

text: 女方呢？
en: And the wife?

text: 一直没有再婚，到现在已经50多了，女儿已经长大，送到国外读书，她仍孑然一身。
en: She has never remarried; now she is already over 50, the daughter has grown up and been sent abroad to study, and she remains entirely alone.

text: 容颜嘛，10年前有一次住院后脸上绑了绷带，我猜可能是拉皮去了。
en: As for her looks, ten years ago, after one hospital stay, her face was bound with bandages; I suspect she probably went for a facelift.

text: 现在呢，毕竟岁月不饶人，年龄摆在那，虽不难看，但美貌不再。
en: Now, after all, time waits for no one and age is there for all to see; she is not unpleasant to look at, but her beauty is gone.

text: 早年，时常因被母亲唠叨而黯然泪下。
en: In earlier years, she would often be brought to tears by her mother's nagging.

text: 她母亲见到熟人总是说，自己什么都好，就是女儿没有一个家。
en: Her mother, whenever she met acquaintances, would always say that everything about her daughter was good, except that her daughter had no family of her own.

text: 以她的条件，当年不过35岁，外形靓丽，家庭优渥，高学历，关键部门公务员，除了带一个孩子拖累外，可以说条件相当好了，为什么没结婚？
en: Given her conditions — at the time only 35, attractive, from a well-off family, highly educated, a civil servant in a key department — apart from the drag of bringing a child, one could say her circumstances were quite good; so why did she not marry?

text: 主要原因在于：
en: The main reasons are:

text: 1、条件好的女性对男方要求也高。
en: 1. Women with good conditions also set high demands on the man.

text: 以本例看，年轻时候找男朋友本就是百里挑一。
en: Taking this case as an example, when she was young finding a boyfriend was already one in a hundred.

text: 虽然35岁了，因自己身条件不错，心里仍然住着白马王子，傲娇得不行。
en: Although she was 35, because her own conditions were good, there still lived in her heart a Prince Charming, and she was insufferably proud.

text: 她不可能找低学历的，不可能找家庭差的，不可能找长得一般的男人，也不可能去找45岁以上的老男人。
en: She could not look for a man with low education, could not look for one from a poor family, could not look for one of ordinary looks, nor could she look for an old man over 45.

text: 这样，形式上符合她条件的人，周围本来就十分稀少，再考虑到要双方三观一致，就更少了。
en: Thus those who formally met her conditions were already extremely few around her, and once one also takes into account the need for both sides to share the same values, there were even fewer.

text: 结果是，她看得上的，基本上都是早已结婚。
en: The result was that those she looked up to were basically all already married.

text: 2、条件好的男性对女性要求也高。
en: 2. Men with good conditions also set high demands on women.

text: 如果一个40岁男性，多金、多才、帅气，就算离婚后再婚，他也一般会找一个年轻、漂亮、学历好、家庭条件较好、性格温柔、甚至未婚的女性。
en: If a 40-year-old man is wealthy, talented and handsome, even if he remarries after divorce he will generally look for a woman who is young, beautiful, well educated, from a fairly good family, gentle in character, and even unmarried.

text: 很难看得上一个35岁，离异、个性很强、带孩的女人，即便她长得漂亮。
en: It is hard for him to take a fancy to a 35-year-old divorced woman with a strong personality and a child, even if she is beautiful.

text: 因为同样漂亮，但年轻、未婚的女孩多的是。
en: Because there are plenty of girls who are just as beautiful but young and unmarried.

text: 最终的结果，就是无法匹配。
en: The eventual outcome is simply that they cannot match.

text: 要么女方看不上男方，要么男方看不上女方。
en: Either the woman looks down on the man, or the man looks down on the woman.

text: 这个案例，引发的思考不仅仅是再婚问题，还有如何经营婚姻。
en: This case prompts reflection not only on the issue of remarriage, but also on how to manage a marriage.

text: 当年很多人劝她不要离婚。
en: Back then many people advised her not to divorce.

text: 15年后回头看，她是做对了，还是做错了呢？
en: Looking back after 15 years, did she do the right thing, or the wrong thing?

text: 除了父母和女儿的遗憾外，我不知道她这15年多来，是否有过男人。
en: Apart from the regret felt by her parents and daughter, I do not know whether in these past 15-odd years she has had any man.

text: 如果有，很可能她自己也跟前夫一样犯了错，当了第三者。
en: If she has, very likely she herself, like her ex-husband, made a mistake and became the other woman.

text: 如果没有，她的确坚守了自己的信条，然而人这一生啊，到底为何坚守，为谁坚守？
en: If she has not, she has indeed held fast to her own creed; yet in this life of ours, in the end why do we hold fast, and for whom?

text: p.s：评论区老有好事者揪住“千万市值”涉嫌腐败说事。
en: P.S.: In the comments section there are always busybodies who seize on the “ten-million market value” as suspected corruption and make an issue of it.

text: 这里说明一下：
en: Here is a clarification:

text: 1、本帖的主旨是以案例来讨论婚姻问题，情节当然必须符合生活逻辑，至于具体人和事是否完全真实，其实并不重要。
en: 1. The main purpose of this post is to discuss the issue of marriage through a case; the plot of course must accord with the logic of life, and as for whether the specific people and events are entirely true, it does not really matter.

text: 我提到的一些信息，也只是听说，并未调查。
en: Some of the information I mentioned was merely heard by rumour and was not investigated.

text: 2、体制内人员各有各的背景，身家几千万，几亿的，组织部门都会要求申报并核查。
en: 2. People within the system each have their own background; those worth tens of millions or hundreds of millions, the organisation department will require them to declare and verify.

text: 只要能说明合法来源，并不违法。
en: So long as one can account for a lawful source, it is not unlawful.

text: 不能简单说谁有几千万，就是腐败分子。
en: One cannot simply say that whoever has tens of millions is a corrupt element.

text: 3、人家前夫是国企人员后来转任公务员的，这种发展路径在体制内很常见。
en: 3. Her ex-husband was a state-owned-enterprise employee who later transferred to become a civil servant; such a career path is very common within the system.

text: 90年代，很多国企改制，股票根本没人要，需要动员企业人员甚至体制内人员购买，以便顺利推进改革。
en: In the 1990s, many state-owned enterprises were restructured; shares were simply unwanted, and enterprise staff and even people within the system had to be mobilised to purchase them, so as to advance the reform smoothly.

text: 购买者不仅不违法，甚至还被视之为改革做贡献之举。
en: The purchasers were not only not breaking the law, but were even regarded as having made a contribution to the reform.

text: 这些原始股是一种风险投资，命运各不相同。
en: These original shares were a kind of venture investment, with varied fates.

text: 有的改革经营失败，变成了废纸。
en: Some reforms failed in their management, and the shares turned into waste paper.

text: 也有的企业后来上市了，股份增值巨大。
en: Some enterprises later listed on the market, and their shares appreciated enormously.

text: 比如大家熟悉的紫金矿业，2000年股改时，当地不少体制内的人都有购买。
en: Take the well-known Zijin Mining, for instance: at the time of its 2000 share reform, many people within the system locally bought some.

text: 当时的原始股面值0.1元，实际只值几分钱，据说很多人拿股票到食堂兑换馒头。
en: At the time the face value of the original shares was 0.1 yuan, but they were actually worth only a few fen; it is said many people took their shares to the canteen to exchange for steamed buns.

text: 谁知道后面上市后这么值钱？
en: Who could have known that afterwards, once listed, they would be worth so much?

text: 价值翻了几百倍。
en: Their value multiplied several hundredfold.

text: 有熟悉的体制内人员科长，就是因为持有紫金矿业的原始股，现在身家超过5000万，周围的同事大家都知道，他也如实向组织申报了。
en: A section chief I know within the system, precisely because he held original shares of Zijin Mining, now has a net worth of over 50 million; his colleagues around him all know this, and he also truthfully declared it to the organisation.

text: 这种情况，在紫金矿业的老家长汀县绝不是个案，不涉及违纪违法。
en: Such a situation is by no means an isolated case in Changting County, the old home of Zijin Mining, and involves no violation of discipline or law.
